Structure shipped + real market list/prices/SKAI-points. THE 375/768 REGRESSION IS FIXED 2026-08-05. RewardsMarketTable used to reach small screens by HIDING cells - Min. Shares and Competitiveness below lg, Reward and Earnings below md - so a phone lost all four of the figures this screen is built around, silently, with no heading and no reason left behind. That is strictly worse than the honest em dash those cells carry, because an absent row reads as 'this screen has nothing to say' rather than 'this number has no source yet'. The row is now ONE DOM structure that restyles: a two-column stacked card below lg where every figure carries its own inline label, snapping to the frame's seven-column table at lg where the header strip returns. Two rendered copies behind lg:hidden / hidden lg:block was rejected - it duplicates every question, price and link in the a11y tree. Pinned by 4 new tests in tests/pages/predict/PredictRewards.test.tsx (labels present and not bare-hidden, no md:block/lg:block anywhere in a row, prices survive, header strip is lg-only). (1) It is not a Dashboard family. vverify filed 3269-17599 as a "layout 2 ALT variant of the Dashboard" and left it deferred against PredictDashboardScreen; reading the Figma layer tree shows both frames are the desktop /predict ROOT at 1440 — the same screen as 8583-127820 / 8610-163972, with the same All-prediction-markets grid, the same four card archetypes (Aston villa AVL 18% / Chelsea CHE 83% three-odds, the Miguel Diaz-Canel multi-deadline card, the Elon Musk 260-349 / 350-460 numeric buckets, the chance-donut card), Show more markets, Breaking news 1-5, Hot topics and the four-question FAQ. So this family maps to PredictPage. (2) The second frame, 10097-220101, had NO vverify row at all, so the family's unknown verdict rested on one of its two frames; it is now read and is the same screen minus the footer and ticker tail. NOT obsolete-by-code either — the "no layout2 switch exists" observation is true and beside the point, because these are alternative COMPOSITIONS of one route, not a runtime mode. Already built and reachable: the grid, Breaking news (PredictInsightsPanel -> MoverRow), the FAQ (PredictFaq), and as of this pass the Home/Help/Terms/Privacy footer (SiteFooter) — the ticker strip is the app-wide fixed HomeBottomTicker the shell already mounts. Five named gaps remain, each with a reason rather than a TODO: the GER 1-0 POR live sports scoreboard hero (no live sports feed — the sportsbook ODDS key is revoked), Hot topics (wants sUSD traded TODAY; only lifetime volume exists), a "Tweet markets" nav tab (no tweet-market venue), a "Top movers" block (event + leading candidate + delta, which needs multi-candidate events and the board has none), and the two declined card archetypes. Whether David still wants this composition is a product question, but it is no longer an unidentified frame.

FULLY ASSESSED 2026-08-05 — 18 of 18 frames now opened, zero unassessed, zero deferred. (The earlier "likely obsolete, same as layout 2 ALT" note was already corrected: these are 18 MOBILE 375x812 frames and they are SKAI's own work — Skai chrome, Skai type, current card set — not borrowed art.) The 10 frames left hanging by the previous pass were settled by reading the Figma LAYER TREE rather than re-rendering, which is what unblocked the 3 that could only be screenshotted as ~71px thumbnails: text-node names survive at any zoom. Every one of the 10 is the short-window "Bitcoin 5min (up/down)" market — 10211-14686 (full-scroll, plus a Predict/Trending nav), 10252-79268 and 10252-84286 (full-scroll, expanded book; the height matches to 10518-23341 and 10509-19476 were identity after all), 10318-26211 and 10318-27037 (expanded book + an Outcome: Down / Outcome: Up settlement sheet), 10315-21225 and 10315-22106 (expanded book, no overlay — and 22106 is a byte-identical duplicate of 21225 at a different canvas x, not a new screen), 10315-24206 (expanded book + a limit ticket), 10252-82221 and 10252-79831 (collapsed book + the One-click $5 -> Win $500 rail). So the family splits 16 / 2: SIXTEEN frames are the one screen this catalog has repeatedly declined — no venue (parimutuel, binary CPMM, scalar CPMM) exposes a price-to-beat, a per-second countdown, a payout multiplier or a price series, both HIP-4 venues are CPMM so the 11-row book has nothing to list, and neither venue has limit orders — and TWO (10199-104649, 10202-112785) are the mobile root list, which is why the family stays partial: they inherit the root's remaining card-archetype gap and nothing more.

TWO OF THE THREE GAPS CLOSED 2026-08-05. (1) The FAQ block now renders on the root as src/components/predict/PredictFaq.tsx — the detail-page FaqPanel could not be reused because buildFaq() is market-scoped and there is no market in scope on the root, so this is a platform-level accordion with the frame's four questions. (2) The multi-date grouped card is built as src/components/predict/GroupedMarketCard.tsx over src/lib/predict/eventGroups.ts, which folds sibling markets that differ only by a trailing deadline into one card; every row still shows its own market's real price and trades through its own venue modal, and the match rule is deliberately strict (same venue, same category, stem ≥20 chars, 2–6 rows) so unrelated markets are never presented as one event. STILL OPEN: the two-team three-odds sports card — DECLINED, not deferred, because no SKAI venue is 3-outcome and the DRAW button would have to carry an invented price. ★ As of 2026-08-05 that decline is the ONLY item left on this family: no buildable gap remains. The footer question was settled by reading the layer tree — 10509-18308 runs Show more markets -> FAQ -> Bottom-navigation-mobile at y=1730 and draws NO footer, unlike the 1440 cut. PredictPage renders SiteFooter at every width regardless, recorded as an accepted divergence (every other content screen ships it at all widths, and the shell's pb-(52px+safe-area) below lg keeps it clear of the bottom nav). Held at `partial` rather than flipped to `done` on purpose: the frame contains an element that cannot be built truthfully, and calling the family done would erase that.

Figma 10597-63994 / 10597-64475 / 10654-203686 / 10654-206593 draw a live plus "Starting soon" sports board: per-event cards carrying two team rows, each with three priced odds buttons (e.g. "LVLUP +1.5 35c"). Nothing under src/pages/predict or src/components/predict* renders a two-team three-odds card - UnifiedMarketCard is a single-question Yes/No card and FuturesMarketCard is a candidate ranking. The only two-team sportsbook in the repo is src/pages/sports/Sports.tsx at /sports (and sports.skai.trade), a separate IA that no /predict route and no PredictSubNav tab links to.

Mobile (10539-46305, 10545-47421) and tablet (10654-197572, 10710-132119) stack four blocks: a hero card, a numbered 1-15 movers list (question + chance + delta), a 'Get daily updates' email-capture card, and a 'Live from @skai.predict' timestamped signals feed. TWO of the four now have implementations. The hero is PredictHero rendering its honest no-featured-market shell. The movers list is BUILT 2026-08-05 - PredictInsightsPanel renders a real ranked MoverRow list off signedProbabilityMoveBps over the priorProbability join - and falls back to its stated-empty panel only because outcome_trades holds zero rows, which is a measurement rather than a hardcoded impossibility. THE OTHER TWO ARE NOW DECLINES, NOT BACKLOG — investigated 2026-08-05 and neither can ship honestly. The 'Get daily updates' email-capture card: `waitlist_emails` exists but it is the skai.trade LANDING waitlist synced to Customer.io, and there is no predict daily-digest sender anywhere in src or supabase/functions, so the card would take an address against a mail that will never be sent — or quietly enrol the user in an unrelated list. The 'Live from @skai.predict' signals feed: that handle does not exist. grep across src, modules/skai-bot and supabase returns zero hits for `skai.predict`, and the only official accounts the codebase knows are instagram.com/skai.trade and x.com/SkaiTrade. A feed 'live from' an account nobody owns can only be fabricated. Recorded as declines so they stop reading as unstarted work; the family stays partial because the movers list is measured-empty (outcome_trades zero-row), which is data, not code.

Mobile (10597-66077, 10710-131349) and tablet (10654-208482, 10710-132635) tier of the futures list: heading, three-tab nav, and ranking cards ("Premier League winner", "2nd/3rd Place winner", "Last place", "Relegated club") whose rows are avatar + percentage + probability bar - which is FuturesMarketCard, and the screen grid collapses to one column below lg.
